Did you experience any sudden onset of severe shortness of breath, chest pain, or wheezing that might suggest a pulmonary embolism or pneumothorax?

text: No, my breathing has been getting worse gradually over the last two months rather than starting suddenly. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD), likely with an emphysema component given the X-ray findings and significant smoking/dust exposure history.
